_comments: SEPARATE speech-to-speech test assistant 'Summit Air – S2S'. Never the phone assistant: its id lives in VAPI_S2S_ASSISTANT_ID (the first live `npm run vapi:sync -- --target s2s` creates it and prints the line to add to .env). OpenAI Realtime gpt-realtime-2 (docs.vapi.ai/openai-realtime): audio in, audio out, no separate transcriber or TTS, so the transcriber is removed and the voice is an OpenAI voice ('marin'; others: alloy, echo, shimmer, cedar). Same 7 tools, credential, events server URL and phone-call-control padding as the main assistant. The prompt renders with S2S true (see the <<#S2S>> sections). Voice variants don't apply here (the target's voice wins).
